backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, MarketIntelligence, Poll, Alert, etc.) and including mixins for storage, authorization, and HTTP outcalls for the RBS DeFi platform backend.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining OldActor and NewActor state shapes and a `run` function that migrates from the old state to a new state adding per-principal Market Pulse vote tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (Market Intel page passcode gate, G-Man signal generator UI, section removals) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's React components, pages, hooks, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'RBS Official V2.5 Institutional DeFi Hub' and mounting the app via `/src/main.tsx`.
frontend/NO_VISUAL_CHANGES_ALERTS_BACKEN: Documentation specifying that the alerts system build is backend-only, listing the new backend methods and React Query hooks added without any frontend visual or styling changes.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the React application with TanStack Router, React Query, and theme providers, defining all routes and a root layout with header, footer, and navigation components.
frontend/src/components/AdminApiKeysPane: Admin panel component for viewing and updating API keys for external data providers (CoinGecko, Binance, etc.) with status badges and inline editing.
Non-visual component that triggers backend initialization after authentication and invalidates React Query cache to load fresh data for the authenticated user.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Mobile-only fixed bottom navigation bar with icon links to key pages, highlighting the active route.
frontend/src/components/ContactInfoSecti: Displays a grid of contact and community links (WhatsApp, Telegram, phone, email) with icons, using configuration from redirectConfig constants.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with RBS branding, Telegram and WhatsApp social links, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with logo, desktop nav links, dropdown menus for Resources, Community, and Analytics sections, and a login/logout button using Internet Identity auth.
frontend/src/components/MarketPulseVotin: React component that displays a community market sentiment voting widget (bullish/bearish/neutral) with tally percentages, session-persisted vote state, and Internet Identity authentication gating.
frontend/src/components/PageHead.tsx: Utility React component that imperatively sets the document title and meta description tag based on provided props.
frontend/src/components/PollCreationSect: React component providing a UI to create community polls and vote on existing ones, using a hardcoded market intel access code and displaying live vote percentage bars.
frontend/src/components/ScrollToTop.tsx: Component that auto-scrolls to the top on route changes and renders a floating button to manually scroll to the top when the user has scrolled past 500px.
frontend/src/components/SignalGeneratorW: Multi-step wizard UI for selecting a market category, asset, and timeframe before triggering an AI signal generation callback.
frontend/src/components/SignalOutputCard: Display card that renders the AI-generated trading signal result including signal label, indicator rows, and styled loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/SmokySectionTran: Wrapper component that uses IntersectionObserver to trigger a smoky fade-in CSS animation when a section scrolls into view, with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/constants/redirectConfig.ts: Defines and exports social/external link configuration constants for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Binance Square, plus a helper to return a mobile deep link or web URL for Binance.
frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts: Re-exports a flat SOCIAL_LINKS object mapping platform names to URLs derived from REDIRECT_CONFIG.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminConfig.ts: Provides React Query hooks for checking admin status, fetching API key statuses (currently mocked), and setting API keys via mutations.
Thin wrapper hook that checks whether the current user has Market Intel access and exposes the result with a loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommunityVoting.ts: Aggregates poll-related queries and mutations into a single hook for creating polls, casting votes, and refreshing poll data by join code or globally.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdownTimer.ts: Fetches presale or airdrop timer end times from the backend actor and drives a live countdown display, falling back to hardcoded timestamps on error.
frontend/src/hooks/useCryptoNews.ts: Fetches and normalizes the latest crypto news from the CryptoPanic public API, deriving sentiment from vote counts and caching results for 12 hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useGenerateSignal.ts: Computes technical trading signals (RSI, MACD, EMA, Bollinger Bands, ATR, etc.) from fetched OHLCV data and applies a weighted scoring system to produce a labeled buy/sell signal.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useLivePrice.ts: Polls the CoinGecko API every 7 seconds to return live price, 24h change, market cap, and volume for a fixed set of major cryptocurrencies.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketIntelLive.ts: Fetches OHLCV and price data from CoinGecko for multiple coins, computes RSI and MACD client-side, and returns scored BUY/SELL/HOLD signals with confidence percentages.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarketPulse.ts: Fetches Bitcoin price and 30-day chart data from CoinGecko, computes RSI and MACD indicators locally, and returns a market pulse status (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral) via a React Query hook that refreshes every 20 seconds.
Provides two hooks: one to query the on-chain market pulse vote tally via the backend actor, and one mutation to submit a sentiment vote (bullish/bearish/neutral) requiring authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Exports two hooks—useParallax for scroll-based parallax offsets and usePointerParallax for pointer-movement-based offsets—both respecting the prefers-reduced-motion media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for backend actor interactions including user profile CRUD, market intel access gating, and alert management (create, read, mark-as-read, delete).
frontend/src/hooks/useRealWorldAnalytics: Fetches global crypto market data (market cap, BTC/ETH dominance, 24h volume, etc.) from CoinGecko's /global endpoint and exposes it via a React Query hook refreshing every 60 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useReliableAuth.ts: Wraps Internet Identity login/logout with race-condition prevention, a 30-second safety timeout, and automatic retry on 'already authenticated' errors, invalidating React Query cache on auth state changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useTokenAdvancedAnaly: Looks up a token by symbol on CoinGecko, then fetches coin details and 30-day chart data to compute RSI, Bollinger Bands, volatility, volume trend, and an overall market strength score.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for a gold-and-white design system, and sets up ambient background animations with reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page describing RBS's mission and key features (security, speed, governance, etc.) using cards with parallax and smoky transition animations.
frontend/src/pages/AcquisitionPage.tsx: Token acquisition page with tabbed Presale and Airdrop registration forms, countdown timers that unlock submission, and WhatsApp redirect on submit.
frontend/src/pages/AdultFormPage.tsx: Age-verification form (18+) that collects personal identity details and submits them via a prefilled WhatsApp message using the openWhatsApp utility.
frontend/src/pages/AdvancedAnalyticsPage: Token analytics page with a symbol search input that fetches and displays advanced metrics (Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD, trend signal, risk level, volume trend) via the useTokenAdvancedAnalytics hook.
frontend/src/pages/AISentimentPage.tsx: Displays a list of crypto news articles with AI/community sentiment labels (positive/negative/neutral), a 12-hour cache countdown, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/AlertsCenterPage.tsx: A page for managing on-chain persistent alerts, allowing authenticated users to create, read, mark as read, delete, and toggle alerts, with a lock screen shown to unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityGovernancePa: A static informational page describing the RBS community governance system, including the proposal process, voting power mechanics, and governance timeline.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityHighlightsPa: A static page showcasing community achievements, featured members, initiatives, and stats for the RBS ecosystem with milestone data and icons.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityVotingPage.t: An interactive community polling page where users can join polls by code, cast votes, and create new polls (gated by a passcode), with real-time vote percentages displayed.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: A contact page with a form that opens a mailto link and direct channel links to Telegram and WhatsApp for reaching the RBS team.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperBlogPage.tsx: A stub developer blog page component with imports for cards, badges, and layout components but no implemented content body.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperToolsPage.ts: A stub developer tools page component with imports for cards, buttons, and icons but no implemented content body.
frontend/src/pages/EcosystemGrowthPage.t: Displays the RBS ecosystem growth strategies page with four cards covering Community Expansion, Market Penetration, Product Development, and Value Creation, each showing key metrics. Uses parallax scrolling and smoky section transitions for visual effects.
frontend/src/pages/FAQPage.tsx: Renders a collapsible FAQ page with ten questions and answers covering RBS token details, governance, tokenomics, launch timeline, presale/airdrop participation, and security. Uses a stateful accordion pattern to toggle individual FAQ items.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: The main landing page featuring a hero section with the RBS logo and call-to-action buttons linking to the acquisition and whitepaper pages, followed by a platform features grid showcasing trading intelligence, analytics, and governance cards.
frontend/src/pages/IndicatorsGuidePage.t: Educational page explaining technical trading indicators (RSI, MACD, and others) using an accordion layout with descriptions, settings, and interpretation guidance for each indicator.
frontend/src/pages/InsightsPage.tsx: Real-time crypto market insights page that fetches and displays global market data (total market cap, BTC dominance, active cryptocurrencies, etc.) via the useRealWorldAnalytics hook, auto-refreshing every minute with loading skeletons and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/LivePricePage.tsx: Displays real-time prices for the top 5 cryptocurrencies, refreshing every 7 seconds, with authentication guard via Internet Identity. Shows price, market cap, volume, and 24h change with loading skeletons and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/MarketIntelPage.tsx: Passcode-gated Market Intelligence page powered by G-Man AI that provides trading signal generation, market pulse voting, contact info, and poll creation. Requires Internet Identity login and a valid passcode for access.
frontend/src/pages/MarketPulsePage.tsx: Shows real-time Bitcoin market sentiment (Bullish/Bearish/Neutral) with live RSI, MACD, price, and 24h change indicators, auto-refreshing every 20 seconds. No authentication required.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 error page with navigation buttons to go home or go back, plus quick-links to key site sections like Tokenomics, Roadmap, Whitepaper, and Contact.
frontend/src/pages/PartnersPage.tsx: Static page listing RBS ecosystem partners grouped into Strategic, Technology, and Community categories, each displaying partner name and role badges.
frontend/src/pages/RoadmapPage.tsx: Displays the RBS development roadmap as a vertical timeline with five phases from 2026 to 2028, each showing status (completed/in-progress/upcoming) and milestone bullets with parallax animation.
frontend/src/pages/SecurityTransparencyP: Displays a security and transparency page for RBS with four feature cards (audits, multi-sig, transparency, reports) using parallax and smoky transition animations.
frontend/src/pages/TestimonialsPage.tsx: Renders a testimonials page with a carousel of six community member quotes and a stats grid showing community size, token holders, security score, and satisfaction rate.
frontend/src/pages/TokenomicsPage.tsx: Shows RBS token distribution via a Recharts pie chart and lists utility features (staking, governance, fees, premium tools) with parallax and smoky transition effects.
frontend/src/pages/WhitepaperPage.tsx: Renders a multi-chapter whitepaper page with a sticky sidebar navigation that highlights the active chapter using IntersectionObserver and smooth scroll.
frontend/src/utils/timers.ts: Exports a single utility function that converts a nanosecond bigint duration into zero-padded days, hours, minutes, and seconds strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Exports helpers to build, open, or redirect to a WhatsApp URL pre-filled with a formatted message using the configured direct number from REDIRECT_CONFIG.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch/hsl CSS variables), border radii, box shadows, keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file describing the RBS website's current features, architectural notes, known issues, and versioned feature list — covering the Market Intel passcode gate, G-Man Intelligence AI signal generator, Market Pulse voting, and related UI flows.
